images.caption: An example of an HDR image tone mapped.  The specific goal of this HDR/tone-mapping function was to recreate the visual experience of human sight near sunset.  The top image series is the individual images combined to make the HDR image with the exposure values above.  The center image was tone mapped with Photoshop-HDR-reduce-to-8-bit function.  Surrounding the center image is the 0.0ev exposure.  All post-processing was done to enhance vibrancy, while still maintaining a realistic color experience.
images.alt: An example of an HDR image tone mapped.  The specific goal of this HDR/tone-mapping function was to recreate the visual experience of human sight near sunset.  The top image series is the individual images combined to make the HDR image with the exposure values above.  The center image was tone mapped with Photoshop-HDR-reduce-to-8-bit function.
